proposals.evidence: The dakṣiṇa article specifically gives Palula dechiṇi, Kohistani Shina daṣuṇu, Kalasha drä̃cũri with intrusive r, and Bshk lāchim remodeled with paścima. These survey northern affricate/sibilant right forms fit those named regional series; Bshk l-initial forms preserve the documented analogical mixture. This is a qualified regional-family assignment and does not erase source transcription differences or claim every shortened ending is regular.
